description: Capability registry for Atomic Rain classic. Capability IDs are stable; concrete tools are selected from references/tool-config.md and references/tooling/ playbooks.

runtime_discovery.path_policy: Prefer configured local tool directories, then PATH. Record command, exit code, and first-pass signal fields.

capabilities.fallback: Use another HTTP-capable CLI only if command, status, length, and timing can still be recorded.
Reduce rate or switch between ffuf and dirsearch; preserve output artifact path.
Treat scanner output as candidate only; require manual first-pass validation before confirmed status.
Run manual boolean/time/error confirmation before sqlmap. Do not launch full exploitation without signal evidence.
Use alternate recon tools and record source confidence; avoid treating OSINT-only assets as confirmed live targets.
Use grep as heuristic evidence only unless validated dynamically or by a stronger data-flow tool.
Do not run destructive gadget payloads without HITL. Prefer detection and safe proof first.
DNS record checks may run locally; sending spoofed mail requires P3.5 HITL approval and supplied recipient.
Require local device/app setup. If unavailable, record blocked state rather than fabricating coverage.
Do not use public OOB services by default. Mark blocked when no approved listener is available.
